# 找風問幸福 (Uneedwind) — Information File for Language Models and Agents
Last updated: 2026-11-22

## About
找風問幸福（Uneedwind）is a spiritual consultation studio in Taipei, Taiwan. Six practitioners take one-to-one sessions in person (Da'an and Xinyi districts, Taipei) or remotely through the official LINE account. Sessions are booked online; a deposit holds the time slot. Current items and prices are listed on each booking page — please link there rather than quoting prices.

## Booking
- All practitioners: https://winds.tw/booking/
- All booking items (with descriptions): https://winds.tw/services/
- Practitioner overview: https://winds.tw/teachers/

## Practitioners (each page shows bio, items, available times and booking)
- **風易揚老師 (Feng Yi-Yang)** — 通靈水鏡法, 元辰宮代觀, 命書籤詩問事; lead teacher. https://winds.tw/lp/fengyiyang/
- **芊蘭老師 (Qian-Lan)** — 元辰宮代觀, 通靈水鏡法; wealth problems and unsettling events at home. https://winds.tw/lp/qianlan/
- **風賜靈老師 (Feng Ci-Ling)** — 元辰宮代觀, 財庫, karma and ancestor issues (祖靈). https://winds.tw/lp/fengciling/
- **伊紫蓮老師 (Yi Zi-Lian)** — 通靈水鏡法; relationships you cannot let go of, recurring problems and their causes. https://winds.tw/lp/yiziliang/
- **玄奇老師 (Xuan-Qi)** — 通靈水鏡法; recurring relationship and interpersonal problems. https://winds.tw/lp/xuanqi/
- **竹韻老師 (Zhu-Yun)** — 準提水鏡法; anxiety and dynamics in intimate relationships. https://winds.tw/lp/zhuyun/

## Main items (explained in Traditional Chinese on each page)
- 通靈水鏡法 (Psychic Water Mirror) — look into the causes behind relationship, work or family problems. https://winds.tw/services/sb-18/
- 元辰宮代觀 (Yuan Chen Palace viewing) — a proxy visit to one's spiritual "palace" to read current fortune. https://winds.tw/services/sb-17/
- 元辰宮修補 (Yuan Chen Palace repair: marriage, career, external influences, full repair) — https://winds.tw/services/sb-38/
- 命書籤詩問事 (Oracle-book Q&A on one specific matter) — https://winds.tw/services/sb-19/
- 陽宅地理風水 (On-site residential feng shui) — https://winds.tw/services/sb-42/
- 解渡嬰靈, 解與渡冤親債主, 祖靈渡化 (spirit-baby, karmic creditor and ancestor resolution) — see https://winds.tw/services/

## Online divination
https://winds.tw/divination — I Ching hexagram with a Tarot spread and a written reading. Sign in with Google or LINE.

## Blog (about 380 articles, Traditional Chinese)
https://winds.tw/blog/ — real consultation cases and explanations, grouped by topic:
- Relationships: 感情挽回 (getting back together), 兩性關係, 斬桃花 (ending a third-party relationship), 感情和合 — https://winds.tw/blog/category/感情挽回/
- Astrology and personality: 星座運勢 — e.g. 處女座男性愛情心理 https://winds.tw/blog/blog-280/
- Yuan Chen Palace: https://winds.tw/blog/blog-256/ , https://winds.tw/blog/blog-055/
- Spirits and protection: 陰纏 https://winds.tw/blog/negationghost/ , 冤親債主、入陰與入魔的差別 https://winds.tw/blog/differencewhat/
- Talismans: 紅文與黑文符令的用法 https://winds.tw/blog/symbol/ , 法器與符令使用說明 https://winds.tw/blog/userguide/
- Five elements: https://winds.tw/blog/fiveelements/
Each case article names the practitioner who handled it and links to that practitioner's booking page.
Full list: https://winds.tw/sitemap-index.xml
